notes.title: Will you let the moon stay red ?!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41470024/9e6cbce70eb794f6bb1403c6faf0d5d9f9bf6979.png[/img]

Soviet moon base are heavily guarded by special space unit "Cosmos Spetsnaz" They are equipped with the newest space weapons and space battle suits.


[h1]Use variety of weapons to get rid of commies
[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41470024/574009c16f8432afe9c2ed5b8712057c5d415532.png[/img]

Main weapons used by moon base garison

[b]ASC 67[/b] - Assault Space Carabine 
Special version of well known soviet assault rifle

[b]SP 70[/b] - Space Pistol 
Standard weapons for officers and technical personnel of the moon base

[b]Kirov's Gatling[/b] - experimental heavy weapons designed for heavy armored units

More weapons will be presented soon ! [list] 
[b][*] Assault shotgun, [*] Flamethrower, [*] Grenade and rocket launchers, [*] Gauss rifles and more [/b] [/list]


[h1]Guess who's back... 
[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41470024/f734e2022239310d6f8a2b84422361284d390f39.gif[/img]
Discover secrets of soviet moon science facility !


[h3]Development Status
[/h3]
Playable Intro  -[b] 80% done[/b]
Moon base sector 1 - [b]75% done[/b]

Most of core gameplay mechanics are working
Curently we are working on new enemies animations and AI behaviors
Next in line is a bunch of finishers, melee combat and logic puzzles.   

[h1]Stay updated and don't forget to 
Follow and add to wishlist ![/h1]
